latest_release.name: vphone 2.16.1
latest_release.body:
## vphone 2.16.1

A patch release of the changes merged since 2.16.0. Launchpad 2.16 and `VPhone.bundle` 2.16.x stay interchangeable both ways.

**Core Bundle**

- vphoned is built against icli 1.0.0 (was 0.10.0). icli's additions since 0.10.0 (a device passcode unlock API and `InterfaceGeometry`) are not used yet; vphoned's behaviour is unchanged. (#891)
- Rotation: a `display.rotation` the guest refuses (the app in front does not support the orientation, rotation is locked, or the screen is off) no longer puts the device back. The device stays turned and the interface follows once the app, the lock or the screen allows it, including after a turn made with the screen off. `display.orientation` adds `device_degrees`. The VM window turns only when the guest's interface does, and Rotate Left/Right turn from the held pose. (#890)
- GLES on the paravirtual GPU: geometry with negative clip-space depth no longer disappears, and depth testing no longer shows farther geometry through nearer geometry. The new `dyld-cfw-gles_depth_clip` patch (`cfw patch-gles-depth-clip`) converts GLES vertex depth and the renderer's viewport depth together and versions the compiler's shader cache; unsupported layouts are refused, and the TV-family presets leave it off. GLES point-draw and primitive-restart repairs also resolve across more cache layouts. (#882)
- TXM: an App whose main executable keeps its Apple Development signature no longer fails to launch (`NSPOSIXErrorDomain 85`) when the AMFI trust-cache bypass skips profile association. The correction is part of `txm-cfw-executable_remap` and was checked against cloudOS 26.1 to 26.4 TXM images. (#889)
- vphoned: `display.metrics` reports the default display's identity, scale and bounds without needing the interface orientation (#879); `display.layout` reports its monitor flags as Booleans instead of `1`/`0` (#886); `methods.list` describes every method and parameter, with declared enums, defaults and ranges (#884).
- Linux builds of the shared modules: CoreFoundation is imported where it is used, and GLES context matching no longer crashes the Swift optimizer. (#876, #878)

**Launchpad 2.16.1**

- No functional change. The minimum bundle stays 2.16.0 and the helper is unchanged (build 21).
- `vphone-launchpad-2.16.1.zip` is built by CI and not notarized; macOS blocks it the first time you open it (see [Downloads](https://github.com/Lakr233/vphone-cli/blob/main/Documents/en/get-started/downloads.md)).

**Upgrading**

An existing machine gets the new vphoned, guest components and guest patches when its environment is updated (`cfw update-environment`, or Update Guest Environment in Launchpad).

**Validation**

- Release `VPhone` and Launchpad build in CI, with bundle admission and both `vphone-escalator` slices checked before the files are attached. Locally, the Release `VPhone` bundle builds and passes `ValidateBundle.sh`, and Launchpad's test scripts pass.
- This release was not regression-tested on guests as a whole. The individual changes were tested by their authors as described in their pull requests.

Docs · English · 中文 · 日本語 · 한국어
# vphone-cli Run a virtual iPhone on an Apple Silicon Mac. > [!WARNING] > This project has never issued or authorized any cryptocurrency or token, and does not accept cryptocurrency payments or donations. Any cryptocurrency or token issued or promoted in this project's name, or claiming any affiliation with it, is a scam. ![Virtual iPhone running on macOS](Documents/demo.jpeg) vphone-cli runs iOS with Apple's Virtualization.framework and PCC research virtual machines, for security research, reverse engineering, and debugging. ## Documentation Everything else lives on the documentation site: **** - [Quick Start](https://lakr233.github.io/vphone-cli/get-started/quick-start): requirements, host settings, and your first VM with Launchpad. - [Manual](https://lakr233.github.io/vphone-cli/get-started/overview): machines, firmware, storage, networking, and troubleshooting, in English, 中文, 日本語 and 한국어. - [Research Notes](https://lakr233.github.io/vphone-cli/research/): patches, boot chain, restore, and the automation API reference. The sources of the site are in [`Documents/`](Documents/) and [`Research/`](Research/). ## Let an Agent Install It If you use a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) on this Mac, paste the prompt below instead of following the steps by hand. The agent reads the vphone skill, checks what is already set up, installs Launchpad and `VPhone.bundle`, and stops to ask when a step needs you, such as an administrator password or a change in macOS Recovery. ```text Set up vphone on this Mac. Read the skill at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lakr233/vphone-cli/main/Skills/vphone-guest-control/SKILL.md and the files it links under references/ (same folder), then follow them: install the newest notarized vphone-launchpad (not every release has a -notarized zip), put vphone-launchpad-cli on PATH, install the VPhone.bundle that matches Launchpad's series, and check `vphone-launchpad-cli status`. Do not change SIP, boot-args or any other host security setting, and do not create a machine until I confirm the firmware and the free disk space. When a step needs me, tell me exactly what to do and wait. ``` ## Acknowledgements - [wh1te4ever/super-tart-vphone-writeup](https://github.com/wh1te4ever/super-tart-vphone-writeup) - [owngoal-dev/OpenAVB](https://github.com/owngoal-dev/OpenAVB) and [owngoal-dev/OpenSEP](https://github.com/owngoal-dev/OpenSEP), the boot ROMs new VMs start from ## License vphone-cli is released under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
